hook: Stocks, real estate or a business: which one builds wealth faster? In this video I put all three side by side from three angles: the numbers (long-run returns, leverage, failure rates, costs, taxes and time), the psychology that pulls people toward one path, and a playbook for choosing and combining them at every stage of life.
